name: abstinence
description: Long term goal of avoiding something that may have brought pleasure or relief. Abstaining from something may come from a desire to improve, a desire to fit in with a social group, or a previous negative experience. Each instance of abstinence may be easy or a very difficult act of willpower.

guidance.description: If you need help abstaining from something addictive, consider finding a support group or professional help.
For general tips, see guidance in 'willpower'.

variations.name: hesitant abstinence
variations.description: If you're not fully committed to the goal of abstinence, or if there's social pressure to indulge, abstinence may come with some level of regret from missing out on the pleasure.
perceptions: Something really appealing tempts you away from the goal of abstinence.
Social pressure from an important person or group tempts you away from the goal of abstinence.
The goal isn't really that important.
The downside of abstaining is significant.

variations.name: satisfied abstinence
variations.description: May come with satisfaction for living up to your own expectations.
perceptions: Something really appealing tempts you away from the goal of abstinence.
Social pressure from an important person or group tempts you away from the goal of abstinence.

commentaries.quote: Complete abstinence is easier than perfect moderation.
I pass the test. I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.
commentaries.attribution: J.R.R. Tolkein in Fellowship of the Ring
